name: Gear Ledger 3D World
description: A navigable 3D concept world for the CWI Gear Ledger: islands for each department of the Cumulative Web Inc agent company, simulated gear handoffs, presence, and music taste. All data is client-side sample data; the broadcast edition shows a clean director-driven feed for streaming and embedding.
truth_detail: SAMPLE. Every number, agent, handoff count, route, and timeline in this 3D world is illustrative sample data rendered client-side. It is a UX/design concept for the CWI Gear Ledger, not the live ledger. The broadcast edition renders LIVE only when live-data.json is fresh (<60 min); otherwise it shows the honest SAMPLE pill.
